name: Maltby Mega Special 2023
information:
- This competition takes place on a Sunday. Please plan accordingly. 

- Due to venue capacity, we ask that competitors bring a **maximum of one guest each**. Spectators are also only permitted as companions of competitors.

- While the competition takes place in the main floor, you are welcome to sit in the upper area. The kitchen, however, is off limits.

- Please take the time to read the Parking tab if you decide to register. There is limited parking space in front of the venue, but there is space nearby so you should know how to navigate your way to the competition.

- Keep in mind that Multi-Blind takes place at the beginning of the competition, so if you decide to arrive during the event, please be mindful to be quiet until all competitors have finished.


This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MaltbyMegaEventsSpecial2023#29297-please-read-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
